monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The stash-jar guide now offers a genuinely useful capacity, headspace, and ownership-cost planner plus an exact-model acceptance record, while explicitly preserving the original-package no-purchase option. No merchant, product, price, coupon, ranking, product image, or affiliate link was added.

image_qa.note: The pet handoff, stash-jar calculator, and age-gate work use text, semantic controls, tables, and existing brand interface assets. No editorial, product, affiliate, stock, or generated image was added or changed.

search_console.decision: The September 14–October 11 report showed 1,373 impressions, four clicks, 0.3% CTR, and average position 33.5. The only supported position 4–20 non-brand content signal—Stem Cell CBG at 18 impressions, one click, and position 6.2—was materially reinforced on October 15, so repeating that cluster today would risk cannibalization. No Data-led item was selected. One-impression queries, branded homepage noise, HTTP-variant noise, four ashtray impressions, two guide-hub impressions, and the Oklahoma page at position 66.9 were deliberately ignored as too weak, noisy, or outside the target range.

authority.action: Rebuilt the pet accidental-exposure page into a citation-worthy no-delay response card, exact-product/co-ingredient handoff, observation timeline, and access-route audit grounded in current ASPCA, Merck Veterinary Manual, and FDA sources. Reciprocal links strengthen the pet, storage, package-access, and veterinary-label cluster. No outreach was sent and no marginal opportunity was logged.
